seeded.note: Seeded 2026-11-03 from official documents opened in this session. On San Francisco ballots: the San Francisco Department of Elections' Voter Information Pamphlet for the November 3, 2026 Consolidated General Election (https://media.api.sf.gov/documents/N26_EN_VIP.pdf, src:media-api-sf-gov-e4221ecde7) lists "Trustee, Community College Board, one seat (remainder of the current term ending January 8, 2029)" among the nonpartisan offices (p. 4); its ballot worksheet lists "Trustee, Community College Board", "Remainder of the current term ending January 8, 2029", "(Vote for One)" (p. 247); and p. 23 says "Voters will elect three trustees to four-year terms, and one trustee to serve the remainder of an unexpired term." This is a separate contest from the three four-year seats (agenda sf-community-college-board). Candidate: the Department of Elections' page Candidates - November 3, 2026, General Election (https://www.sf.gov/candidates-november-3-2026-general-election, src:sf-gov-6871cf14b5) lists one name under "Community College Board Partial Term" ("1 person has qualified for this contest on the November 3, 2026 ballot."): Ruth Ferguson. The Department's Board of Supervisors and Other Local Offices Chinese-character-based Names and Ballot Designations List (https://api.sf.gov/documents/63094/November_2026_Local_Office_Names_and_Ballot_Designations.pdf, src:api-sf-gov-cd997081d7) prints RUTH FERGUSON with the ballot designation "Appointed Trustee, Community College" under "Community College Board Partial"; the candidate's statement is on p. 36 of the pamphlet. The Candidates page also lists "Write-In Candidates" with "0 people have filed for candidacy for this contest on the November 3, 2026 ballot." No stance questions are set yet.
